sections.heading: PMS Bihar document submission guidelines.
body: The Bihar Post-Matric Scholarship portal mandates that all certificate attachments be clear PDF files under 200 KB. High-resolution scans regularly fail upload validation until compressed.

faq.q: What is the document limit on Bihar Post-Matric Scholarship portal?
faq.a: All certificates uploaded on pmsonline.bih.nic.in must be PDF files under 200 KB.
